humanDecisionNote: Automations and jobs prepare, route, calculate and remind. They never decide a business approval, a gate, an investment or a Finance attestation: those decisions are always taken by a person.

completionRule.all_steps_closed_and_outputs_linked: All steps closed and outputs linked

nextAction.none: No action: the procedure is closed

procedures.mySummary: The procedure steps assigned to you or your role, the procedures you can follow, and the launch of a published procedure.
procedures.myStepsEmpty: No procedure step is waiting for you.
procedures.launchIntro: Starts a new instance pinned to the procedure's published version. A retried launch creates one instance.
procedures.instanceSummary: Current step, assignee, due date, missing inputs, completed evidence, next action and the records it produced.
procedures.pinnedNote: This instance stays on the version it was launched with.
procedures.approvalStepNote: An approval step is completed only by the decision of its business approver, through the business approval. Nothing on this screen approves it.
procedures.approvalStepWaiting: This step waits for its business approval decision.
procedures.noOutputs: No output record is linked yet.

builder.summary: Procedure definitions of the Playbook Studio: purpose, trigger, scope, inputs, ordered, conditional and parallel steps, roles, SLA, approval and escalation paths, outputs, completion and exceptions.
builder.readOnly: You can read procedure definitions. Methodology administrators edit them in a procedures draft of the Playbook Studio.
builder.readOnlyDefinition: Read-only: this version is not an editable procedures draft, or you cannot edit it.
builder.versionIntro: Definitions are edited only in an open procedures draft; the draft is reviewed and published in the Playbook Studio.
builder.needDraft: To change procedures, create or open a procedures draft in the
builder.empty: This version has no procedure definition.
builder.name: Name
builder.editorIntro: Validate shows every finding at once. Save stores the definition in the draft only; nothing is published until the draft is published in the Playbook Studio.
builder.savedDraft: Saved to the draft. This is not published: it applies only after the draft is reviewed where configured and published.
builder.rolesHint: Role codes separated by commas, for example TO, TL. Administrator roles and the auditor are not allowed.
builder.stepsHint: Steps run in position order. Steps with the same position and the same parallel group run in parallel. A step with a condition runs only when its input meets it; otherwise it is not applicable.
builder.valid: Valid: the definition has no finding.
builder.invalid: Not valid: {{count}} finding(s). Correct them and validate again.
builder.removeIntro: Removes this procedure from the draft. Seeded procedures can be edited but not removed.

rules.readOnly: You can read the rules, their versions, dry runs and executions. Methodology administrators change them.
rules.createIntro: A new rule starts disabled, as a draft. Run a dry run, have it reviewed where configured, publish it, then enable it.
rules.codeHint: 3 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, dots or underscores, starting with a letter.
rules.whenHint: The events or schedules that start the rule.
rules.noConditions: No condition: the rule acts on every trigger.
rules.humanOnlyTitle: These are human decisions and cannot be automated:
rules.servicePermissionsHint: Permission codes separated by commas. A service identity cannot hold an approval or Finance validation right.
rules.reviewIntro: A configuration review by someone other than the author. It is not a business approval.

dryRun.title: Dry run
dryRun.intro: Evaluates the draft against a sample event without side effects: no task, notification, execution or business record is created.
dryRun.payloadHint: The event's fields, as the trigger sends them. Synthetic data only.
dryRun.conditionsNotMet: The conditions are not met: the rule would not act.
dryRun.conditionsUnknown: The conditions could not be evaluated.
dryRun.noSideEffects: Nothing was created: this was a dry run.

executions.title: Execution history
executions.intro: Each execution with its rule version, trigger event and outcome.

jobs.title: Job operations
jobs.intro: Each scheduled job with its last success, next run, last outcome, open failures and repair actions.

routes.listTitle: Approval routes of the published methodology
routes.listIntro: In a sequential route a step is notified only after the previous step approves; in a parallel route every step is notified at once.
routes.empty: No approval route is configured: approvals are single-step.
routes.businessNote: Each step is a business approval decided by a person who holds the step's role. No automation or technical administrator decides a step.
routes.notRouted: This business approval has no route: it is decided as a single step.
routes.sequentialNote: Sequential: a later step is not notified until every earlier step has approved.
routes.parallelNote: Parallel: every step was notified at once.
routes.decideIntro: You can decide one step of this approval. You cannot decide a step of your own request.
routes.openRoute: Approval route: its sequential or parallel steps

conditions.title: Gate conditions
conditions.intro: Each condition of a conditional business approval, with its owner and deadline, tracked to closure. Overdue conditions are escalated to the approver.
conditions.note: A conditional approval allows only its permitted scope; its conditions never authorize unrestricted scaling.

prefs.urgentNote: Urgent escalations are always delivered at once, whatever your quiet hours and digest. A notification that waits for a digest never hides its work item: My Work shows the item at once.
prefs.effectiveIntro: Your own preferences when you have saved them; otherwise your organization's defaults. With neither, every notification is delivered at once.
prefs.timezoneHint: An IANA name, for example Asia/Riyadh.
prefs.readOnly: You can read these preferences but not change them.
prefs.quietOn: Hold non-urgent notifications during quiet hours
prefs.quietHint: Quiet hours may span midnight, for example 21:00 to 07:00. Start and end must differ.
prefs.digestHint: Non-urgent notifications are collected into one in-app digest.
prefs.policyIntro: Defaults for everyone in your organization without their own preferences, and business-day timing.
prefs.workingDaysOnly: Deliver non-urgent notifications on working days only

cutoff.title: Cut-off pack
cutoff.intro: The draft agenda and pack generated from current data when the meeting's agenda cut-off was reached. It must be reviewed before its items are published.
cutoff.noneBody: The pack is generated once, when the meeting's agenda cut-off is reached.
cutoff.notPublishable: None of the pack's agenda items can be published until the chair or the secretary reviews the pack.
cutoff.agendaIntro: One draft agenda item per executive ask that was open at the cut-off.
cutoff.noAsks: No executive ask was open at the cut-off.
cutoff.reviewIntro: Marks the pack reviewed. The chair then publishes the items on the meeting page.
